entities.name: Rafqa Pietra Choboq Ar-Rayes

entities.summary: Rafqa Pietra Chobok, also known as Saint Rafka and Saint Rebecca, was a Lebanese Maronite nun who was canonized by Pope John Paul II on June 10, 2001.
